_comment: Import with: sudo nginx-gateway-ctl projects import /path/to/this.json  (or Settings > Import in the dashboard). Ports are examples: use the ones your apps listen on.

projects.name: Prajna
projects.notes: Start with: VITE_API_BASE=/prajna/api npm run dev -- --base /prajna/ --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8200 --strictPort

projects.name: Meeting Transcriber
projects.notes: The backend has many top-level routes (/auth, /voice, ...), so they live under /meeting-transcriber/backend/ with strip_all. Build/start the frontend with VITE_API_BASE_URL=/meeting-transcriber/backend.

projects.name: Smart Finder
projects.notes: Next.js app with many fetch('/api/...') calls: its own gateway port needs no code change. Set FRONTEND_HOST=127.0.0.1 in /etc/smartfinder/smartfinder.conf so only the gateway reaches it.
